CheckTitle: IAM Roles with AdministratorAccess policy attached
Description: IAM roles found with 'AdministratorAccess' policy attached. This policy is overly permissive and should be used sparingly.
Risk: Having too many roles with such privileges poses significant security risks due to the broad and unrestricted permissions that come with this policy.

Recommendation.Text: Inspect the roles, and verify only those that are required to have such privileges have the policy attached.
